More training, measured honestly

External training: J03WOH. Validation: J03WPY. No challenge inputs. The default remains rnn-boundary-001.npz. Extra layers did not win the validation comparison. Reused tests below are retrospective evidence.

Mean clean/dropout spell F1. All three matches were previously viewed; no tuning or architecture choice occurred in this audit. This does not establish fresh-test improvement. The two-layer network achieved lower validation loss, but the one-layer network achieved better spell segmentation. A lower loss does not guarantee better possession intervals.

Overfit and underfit interpretation

All networks initially reduce both losses, indicating useful learning. Later validation loss fluctuates while training loss remains lower. Early stopping retains earlier weights rather than the final weights. This reduces one risk; it does not prove the model is free of overfitting. Repeated reuse of one validation match can itself overfit model selection. More independent matches matter more than adding layers blindly.
